It is not executable identity, build equivalence, source equivalence, compiler or dependency verification, a population theorem, end-to-end formal verification, or downstream validation, and it is not a portable semantic hash. Full tool, source, dependency, claim-packet, and release custody remain separate gates.

A rebuilt, source-manifest-different executable emitted different executable and certificate digests, so a scientifically unchanged replay changed repository bytes and then failed the claim packet's exact evidence projection.
